text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT — cluster-prod/us-east-1 host cluster-host-42 is in CrashLoopBackOff for pods running runtime:v2.4. Page sent to oncall-ryan and sre-amy.

oncall-ryan: acked, joining. seeing ~120 crashloop restarts in last 10m. stack traces show SIGSEGV in fused_kernels.so on cuda mmap.

sre-amy: copying logs and core extracts now. customers showing 502/503 errors on routes: /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate for dedicated-tenant-32. CS notified (cs-jordan).

cs-jordan: customer-reports: "inference failing intermittently since ~22:05 UTC, impacts batch jobs and sync requests". Tier-1 flagged.

runtime-matt: initial hypothesis: segfault in TRT-fused kernel used by vllm adapter when KV cache > 2GB. We rolled v2.4 yesterday with nvmap changes.

infra-lee: node metrics: mem available dropping before crash, but OOM not recorded — kernel panic SIGSEGV from process. NVidia driver 550.102, cuda 11.8. Recent kubelet update at 03/12.

oncall-ryan: steps so far: 1) isolated node cluster-host-42 (cordon) 2) scaled replicas for runtime pool up by +3 to shift traffic 3) enabled fallbacks to cpu-runtime for canary routes. still seeing errors for in-flight requests.

runtime-matt: paste of backtrace:

-----BEGIN LOG BLOCK-----
Thread 1 "runtime" received signal SIGSEGV, Segmentation fault.
#0  0x7f9b4f3a7120 in fused_kernel_execute(cudaStream_t, void*) from /opt/runtime/fused_kernels.so
#1  0x7f9b4f4b2aa0 in trt_execute from /opt/runtime/trt_adapter.so
#2  0x55aa3c2e3f12 in vllm::Engine::run
-----END LOG BLOCK-----

runtime-matt: core dump saved at /var/crash/runtime. I'll grab coredump and try to reproduce locally.

infra-lee: recommended immediate mitigation: revert runtime image to v2.3 for runtime pool, and disable fused_kernels via RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED=1 env var. Preparing rollout patch.

oncall-ryan: performing image rollback for pool runtime-prod-pool-1 -> runtime:v2.3. Rolling update starting now.

ops-bot: deploy started by oncall-ryan — rollout id dpl-7892.

sre-amy: confirm rollback to v2.3 completed on 6/8 pods; monitoring errors.

cs-jordan: customers report partial recovery but still seeing some failures for older sessions pinned to affected hosts. Notifying them of mitigation and escalation.

runtime-matt: additional debug: reproducer script triggers segfault when request context includes kv_cache_size > 2GB and modelChunking=true. Suspect nvmap allocation path in fused_kernels.

infra-lee: node-level fix: draining affected node and rebooting to clear driver state. Doing cordon->drain->reboot.

oncall-ryan: handing off to night oncall (sre-amy) — summary: crashloops due to SIGSEGV in fused_kernels.so after recent runtime v2.4 rollout + nvmap change. Immediate mitigation performed: rolled runtime pool back to v2.3, disabled fused kernels via env toggle, cordoned + drained node, scaled up replicas. Customer impact: dedicated-tenant-32 saw errors ~22:05-22:40 UTC, partial recovery post-rollback. Followups: full postmortem, reproduce and fix fused_kernels nvmap path, add canary gating for runtime builds.

sre-amy: taking over. tasks remaining: 1) validate all pools on v2.3 2) collect and upload core + coredbg info to S3 (s3://redwood-incident/1795556666/) 3) create ticket RINF-4521 to fix kernel and run extended soak tests.

runtime-matt: creating patch branch to disable NVMap optimization and add bounds check. Will open PR + e2e test.

ops-bot: postmortem template created: PM-1795556666 (private).

cs-jordan: sent customer update: "We've rolled back the runtime and are disabling an optimization that caused instability. Engineering is investigating root cause; we'll follow up with a detailed timeline and fix ETA."

sre-amy: monitoring shows 95% of routes normalizing. we'll keep alerts muted for crashloop on cluster-host-42 while drain completes. reopening if regressions.

oncall-ryan: thanks — handing off slack thread and incident artifacts to sre-amy for overnight.

sre-amy: ack, will continue monitoring and coordinate postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
